title: Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Week 6: Woody Marks and Germie Bernard step up

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Week 6: Woody Marks and Germie Bernard step up
sources.description: Germie Bernard and Woody Marks were thrust into larger roles than expected in Week 5. Both players will be asked to step up in Week 6, making them two of the best waiver wire adds this week.
